title: Research
description: What outside sources (documentation, issue trackers, the web) say about a question, with every claim tied to a source.

question.description: The question as you understood it.

answer.description: The answer in a few sentences, or why there is none.

findings.description: The individual facts behind the answer.

source.description: URL, ticket id or path the claim comes from.

quote.description: The exact supporting words, kept short.

sources.description: Every source consulted, with how current it is.

date.description: Publication or last-update date when known.

conflicts.description: Places where sources disagree, or disagree with the code.

open.description: What could not be found or confirmed.
